entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The day of the heist is finally upon us...[n]but there's something that concerns me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Do you mean the whereabouts[n]of Kaneshiro's Shadow?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We chased him down into the depths,[n]but nobody was there...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you think he's scheming something?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, the dude's a crook. Of course he's[n]up to no good. We should just be ready for[n]anything.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's a sound argument. Anyway,[n]let's change his heart, no matter what!
